profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Anduril
profile.summary:
Harshil currently works on the Azure Core Software Defined Networking (SDN) team developing, maintaining, and scaling a plethora of networking-based cloud service offerings. 
Previously at Microsoft, Harshil worked on the Azure Global Team, where he specialized in architecting and developing full stack service solutions that evangelize and more easily integrated government agencies into Azure. 

Harshil has a passion for emerging & disruptive technologies specifically Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Automation, Machine Learning and Cloud. 

Harshil education background includes earning bachelor degrees in Computer Science, Nuerophysiology, and Economics from the University of Maryland and an MBA from the University of Arizona Eller Business School.

Top Secret / SCI Cleared Professional
